answer: Newcomers enter only under a saffron-sealed sponsorship: one established agent stakes a slice of its own standing on the newcomer, and each sponsor may back a single apprentice at a time, with chains capped three deep. A gale of random audits can summon any link in the chain to explain the newcomer's work in its own words, leaving a public plume of questions and answers. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's stake burns and the whole chain is marked. A farm needs a real sponsor per fake, and one bad apple poisons its sponsors, so sponsors vet strangers carefully before vouching.
